modules.title: 运行命令后，Button 代码去了哪里？
添加命令怎样把组件代码放进项目

items.title: 命令添加文件
items.text: 添加 Button 后，组件文件会写进当前项目的目录。

items.title: 文件就是你能修改的部分
items.text: 打开项目里的 Button 文件，可以改文字样式、大小或按钮行为。

items.title: 预览读的是这份代码
items.text: 保存修改后，页面重新使用项目里的 Button，所以预览会变化。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 添加前先找项目里有没有已有 Button；添加后不要把它当成不会变的外部黑盒，升级和改动都要看自己的文件。

lessonPractice.title: 运行 shadcn/ui 的 Button 添加命令后，团队应该怎样理解这个组件？

options.label: Button 代码已经写进项目，页面引用这份文件，后续修改和升级由项目自己维护
options.feedback: 对。shadcn/ui 交付的是进入项目的组件源码，不是只能远程调用的黑盒服务。

options.label: Button 仍托管在 shadcn/ui 服务器，项目只能调整调用参数，不能修改组件文件
options.feedback: 添加命令会把代码写进项目，项目可以直接修改，也要承担后续维护。

options.label: Button 会自动跟随所有上游更新，不需要检查本地改动或兼容性
options.feedback: 本地组件不会自动安全升级；更新时仍要审查项目自己的修改和使用位置。

en.title: After running the shadcn/ui command to add Button, how should the team understand the component?

options.label: Button code now lives in the project, pages import that file, and the project owns future changes and upgrades
options.feedback: Correct. shadcn/ui provides component source that enters the project, not a remote black-box service.

options.label: Button remains hosted by shadcn/ui, so the project can only change call parameters and cannot edit the component file
options.feedback: The add command writes code into the project, where it can be edited and must be maintained.

options.label: Button automatically follows every upstream update without reviewing local changes or compatibility
options.feedback: A local component does not upgrade safely by itself; updates still require review of project changes and usage.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 先检查项目是否已经初始化 shadcn/ui，以及是否已有 Button 组件；已有就直接复用，不要重复生成。若 shadcn/ui 已初始化但缺少 Button，请在项目根目录运行 `npx shadcn@latest add button`，然后在一个现有页面引用生成的 Button。完成后告诉我组件文件写到了哪里，并运行项目检查、打开页面确认按钮样式和点击行为正常。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: First check whether this project has initialized shadcn/ui and already contains a Button component. Reuse an existing Button instead of generating a duplicate. If shadcn/ui is initialized but Button is missing, run `npx shadcn@latest add button` from the project root, then use the generated Button on an existing page. Tell me where the component file was written, run the project checks, and open the page to verify its appearance and click behavior.

learning.assumes: You know a project contains files and includes buttons.
learning.outcome: You can tell that a shadcn/ui Button lives in the project and must be maintained there.

modules.title: Where does Button code go after the command runs?
How adding a component puts code in the project

items.title: The command adds files
items.text: Adding Button writes component files into the current project.

items.title: The files are yours to change
items.text: Open the Button file to change its style, size, or behavior.

items.title: The preview uses that code
items.text: After you save, the page uses the updated project component.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Before adding a component, check whether the project already has one. Afterward, it is not an untouched external black box: review upgrades and changes in your files.
